kicker: Work with me · Independent travel consultant
heading: Latin America, beyond the beaten track.
lead: A partner on the ground for travel agencies: I help you develop Latin America into a reliable and distinctive part of your portfolio, from collaboration to work on the ground.
heroAlt: Buses on the altiplano below the snowy peak of Huayna Potosí, Bolivia

services.title: Designing the trip
services.text: Routes, pace and experiences, shaped into an itinerary that suits your travellers.

services.title: Coordinating on the ground
services.text: Accommodation, transport, guides and local suppliers — arranged in Spanish, within your procedures.

services.title: Support along the way
services.text: With your group in the field, day by day, ready for whatever comes up.

servicesNote: Pick one, or the whole journey from first idea to the field.
whyHeading: Knowledge from the road, not from a catalogue.

reasons.title: Three years in the field
reasons.text: Hidden gems, border crossings, local transport and accommodation — known first-hand.

reasons.title: Spanish without intermediaries
reasons.text: Direct conversations with local partners, so nothing is lost in translation.

reasons.title: One person, start to finish
reasons.text: The same person designs the itinerary and runs it on the ground, so no detail falls through the cracks.

reasons.title: Your brand stays yours
reasons.text: Trips run under your licence, contracts and name. I work as your external specialist.

places: Guatemala · Peru · Bolivia · Colombia · Argentina · Chile · Brazil

steps.title: Conversation
steps.text: Tell me about your travellers and what you'd like to offer.

steps.title: Proposal
steps.text: Based on our conversation, I prepare the route and itinerary, and handle the communication with hosts, guides and hotels.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: We refine the itinerary together, and I coordinate it and accompany the group on the ground.

about: For almost three years I have travelled independently across the Americas, getting to know it first-hand. I write about it on Resplandor, my travel journal, and I want to help agencies build Latin American programmes that are authentic, but also workable.
note: I do not act as a tour operator: trips are delivered under the agency's own licence and procedures.
